lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor five. Same reactor architecture, eighty megawatts. Survey flagged movement above the deck.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Motes. They run cold and they don't reflect — your guns will not see them without a relay lit.
lines.beat: states the mechanic as equipment limitation, not as a rule

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Eight megawatts to see. That's most of a turret.
lines.beat: the anchor's whole decision, priced, in one line

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It is. Run it blind if you'd rather have the gun. I'd not, but it's your board.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Ground contact first. Nothing in the air yet.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: There. That's the rest of them.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: They come in under the guns and over them. Same order, two heights.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It's one order. The order doesn't care which way up you are.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Bus is over. If you drop the relay you'll get the megawatts back and lose the sky.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One past you. Couldn't tell you what it was.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Ring's taking it. Cut something you like.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: That's us overdrawing our own bus. Nobody's doing that to us.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Thirty-five seconds before you can do that again. Spend the window.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Called it early. Money's better spent than idle.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Held. Okonkwo — eleven years, and they still fly a pattern.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: They fly a search. Wide, then narrow, then wide again. Nobody searches a place they built.
lines.beat: the act's real question, said as an observation about flight paths

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Then what are they looking for.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Not us. We'd have been found.
